subject: SOC 2 intake: security review checkpoint & signoffs (MAP)
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Ava Jenkins <ava.jenkins@finsecure.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 15:12:00 +0000
Subject: SOC 2 intake: security review checkpoint & signoffs (MAP)

Hi Ava — thanks again for the call today. Quick post-call recap and proposed MAP milestones so we have a single source of truth.

Key milestones (proposed):
- Security review kickoff (internal FinSecure) — target: 2026-05-24 (owner: FinSecure security team)
- Redwood provides SOC 2 questionnaire (fillable) — target: 2026-05-20 (owner: Redwood: Karthik)
- Evidence bundle intake (logs, IAM lists, config snapshots) — target: 2026-06-11 (owner: Marissa Cole)
- System diagram + retention policy delivery — target: 2026-05-28 (owner: Ben Carter)
- Mutual signoff on readiness for audit/attestation scheduling — target: 2026-06-18 (owners: Redwood + FinSecure)
- Target contract close / capacity go-live — target: 2026-06-25 (sales/procurement)

Dependencies and notes:
- AuditCo availability (third-party auditor) will affect final attestation window — we need FinSecure to confirm auditor availability by 2026-05-26.
- FinSecure security team requested system diagrams and retention policy during the call — Ben will produce a redlined PDF.
- We will use the attached evidence-index-template.csv for intake; Marissa will be primary intake owner.

Immediate asks for FinSecure: please confirm the internal security reviewer and a preferred secure upload method (SFTP, secure Share, or vendor portal). If SSO/service account details are needed for access to specific audit logs, let us know by EOD 2026-05-20.

Attachments (sent with this thread): SOC2-questionnaire-fillable.xlsx, evidence-index-template.csv, redwood-system-diagram-v2.pdf

Link to MAP draft (HubSpot): https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/3742/deal/HS-3742

Thanks — I’ll get the questionnaire into your hands by tomorrow morning.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Thanks Karthik — good summary. A few quick notes from our side: we’ll own the internal security review kickoff and assign a point of contact this week.

- Internal reviewer: Ava Jenkins (security lead) and I’ll loop in our infra lead (security+vendor@finsecure.com) for network-related artifacts.
- Upload method: we prefer a short-lived, pre-authenticated S3 link or our vendor portal. If you can provide an S3 presigned option that would speed intake.
- Required from Redwood: detailed system diagram (incl. VPC/subnets, data flows), retention/backup policy (RPO/RTO), and sample audit logs for the last 30 days.

We’ll run an initial intake on 2026-05-24 and aim to surface any blocking questions by 2026-05-26. If you can confirm the questionnaire owner and who will handle the evidence intake, we’ll add those owners to our MAP and calendar invites.

A few attachments from our side: FinSecure-security-contact.vcf (contact card for infra lead).

Ava — appreciate the clarity. Quick internal commitments from our side so you have named owners: 

- Evidence intake & tracking: Marissa Cole (marissa.cole@redwood.ai) — I’ll own populating the evidence-index-template.csv and the initial upload to the S3 presigned link you provide.
- System diagram & retention policy: Ben Carter (ben.carter@redwood.ai) — Ben will output redwood-system-diagram-v2.pdf and a retention policy doc; targeted delivery 2026-05-27 to give you a buffer.
- Questionnaire owner: Karthik will own delivery and will be the primary coordinator for follow-ups and clarifications.

Adjusted dates (to reflect AuditCo dependency):
- Questionnaire delivered (fillable): 2026-05-20 (as planned)
- Security review kickoff (your internal run): 2026-05-24
- Evidence bundle initial upload: 2026-06-11
- Final readiness check: 2026-06-19 (one week before target close)

Risk/Notes: if AuditCo is not available until late June we may need to push the attestation schedule — please flag auditor availability as soon as you confirm. Also, if FinSecure prefers vendor portal over presigned S3 we can adapt; Marissa will coordinate with your infra contact on permissions.
